newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi briefed on Wednesday's Internal Market Council. She said decisions were expected on the action programme improving awareness of EU law within the legal profession and on the internal market action plan. Olivi said the ministers would also discuss the green paper on public procurement, the results of working groups on the European company statute, the electronic commerce initiative, medical in vitro devices and legislation on ionised foodstuffs.

In answer to a question spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said the Commission had not sent a telegram to the new Democratic Republic of Congo's self-proclamed President Laurent-Desire Kabila. He said the Commission would judge the new government on principles and not on men and would wait for the Lome convention principles to be respected before resuming cooperation with the country.

Asked about the proposal for cotton anti-dumping duties on imports from several Asian countries rejected on Friday, spokesman Peter Guilford said the subject was likely to be raised at Tuesday's foreign minister's meeting in The Hague. If not decided by tommorow the proposal will be dead, Guilford added.

Spokeswoman Lousewies van der Laan said there was no formal reaction from the Commission to Turkey's operation in Northern Iraq. The Commission is still studying the case that is very different from the previous incursions, she said. Van der laan said a reaction might be available in her office in the afternoon.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/418: TACIS: the Commission approves the 1997 action programmes for Ukraine and Kirghizistan.
- IP/97/419: Ritt Bjerregaard: 1996 bathing water report - still one out of three fresh water bathing zones is insufficiently monitored or does not meet the minimum quality requirements.
- IP/97/420: Commission proposes full implementation of competition rules to air transport between the Union and third countries.
- IP/97/421: Commission appoints members of the European consultative forum on the environment and sustainable development.
- Speech/97/113: Speech by Commissioner Christos Papoutsis at Unipede XXIV congress on "Electricity on the move".
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Agriculture, forestry and fisheries No 1997-8: Surveys on the cattle, pig, sheep and goat livestock population carried out in the EU in December 1996.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Agriculture, forestry and fisheries No 1997-9: Developments in the volume of agricultural labour in the EU.
- Provisional agenda for Wednesday's Commission meeting.
- Quality of bathing water report for 1996 bathing season.
